from pathlib import Path
path=Path('validation/2026-11-06-plan-local-reward-stdio-client/commands.json')
command=sys.argv[1:]
env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
try:
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
    record=dict(command=shlex.join(command),interpreter=(str(Path(command[0]).resolve()) if '/' in command[0] else command[0]),exit_code=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,execution_status='completed',started_utc=start)
except OSError as error:
    record=dict(command=shlex.join(command),exit_code=None,stdout='',stderr=str(error),execution_status='unavailable',started_utc=start)
record['interpreter'] = shutil.which(command[0])
record['environment'] = {'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
if 'PYTHONPATH' in env:
    record['environment']['PYTHONPATH'] = env['PYTHONPATH']
records=json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else []
records.append(record)
path.write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(record['command'], '->', record['exit_code'],record['execution_status'])
print(record['stdout'][-1800:])
print(record['stderr'][-2500:])
raise SystemExit(record['exit_code'] or (0 if record['execution_status']=='completed' else 127))
